video_title: Tony Allen Calls Out LeBron AGAIN

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen defends his status as an elite perimeter defender
quotes.excerpt: I am one of the peers. I am speaking.
quotes.quote: We always say our peers are the ones that are going to speak for you in value. I am one of the peers. I am speaking. That is wrong, Bleacher Report. I am one of the peers, I am speaking.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen argues LeBron James would struggle against elite defenders
quotes.excerpt: You got 41 minutes of sticking cephalon lotion. Game gets tight late down the stretch.
quotes.quote: Do you think LeBron James started out the game on Kevin Durant to risk picking up two fouls? No, he is going to stick cephalon lotion. So you got 41 minutes of sticking cephalon lotion. Game gets tight late down the stretch in the last two, three minutes, you get a chasedown block here and there. Then now you get to win, now you are first team all-defense. I disagree.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen asserts his defensive legacy against LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: We known LeBron James for 40,000 points and them chasedown blocks, killer.
quotes.quote: I am telling you, chasedown blocks and all that, I do not know what they got mad at. I am saying, we known LeBron James for 40,000 points and them chasedown blocks, killer.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen questions LeBron James' defensive intensity
quotes.excerpt: He is not coming in the game playing 48 minutes of defense.
quotes.quote: He is not coming in the game playing 48 minutes of defense. I do not care who got a comment. You cannot talk about this if you have not lived this. So all the sports writers, the analytic guys, the fact guys, everybody who is mad, listen. When it is time to get into the hard work and strategically preparing for a game, they do not want LeBron James getting two quick fouls. Period. I am just going to leave it at that.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen highlights his defensive record against Michael Beasley
quotes.excerpt: Tony Allen averaged 8.5 points, 3.3 rebounds and 2.0 steals in 13 games versus Michael Beasley.
quotes.quote: Tony Allen averaged 8.5 points, 3.3 rebounds and 2.0 steals in 13 games versus Michael Beasley in his career. Michael Beasley averaged 10.9 points, 5.8 rebounds and 1.2 assists in 13 games versus Tony Allen in his career. And he lost every one of them. Stamp that. Stamp that.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen addresses Paul Pierce's 50-point game against him
quotes.excerpt: I saw Paul Pierce give him 50 one day in my face though.
quotes.quote: I saw Paul Pierce give him 50 one day in my face though. I saw Paul give him 50. What are you talking about? I saw Paul give 50. I am telling you. No, y'all, but see, it is funny how we forget. Y'all laughing. I am not even trying to, I am just, this actually happened, bro.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen discusses the evolution of defensive assignments
quotes.excerpt: We coming in the league, guys is at the two guard 6'10, 6'8 now.
quotes.quote: We coming in the league, guys is at the two guard 6'10, 6'8 now. So to give up that much in space and still have the energy and the strength to compete and lock guys down, I think it should be a little more credited than what it is. And also it just turned into a big guy award. You go back throughout the history of the defensive player of the year award, it is virtually all big guys.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen reaffirms his respect for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I am a fan of LeBron James though. That is what I am trying to say.
quotes.quote: I am a fan of LeBron James though. That is what I am trying to say. He is cold. He is one of the best to ever do it and doing it his own way. He is heavy. But far as defense, man, we got an argument. It is a barbershop conversation, that is all it is.
